prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1365; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a sedan and an SUV. Driver 1 stated that they were traveling straight through the intersection when Driver 2, operating the SUV, turned left across their path and struck the driver's side of the sedan. Driver 2 stated that they had begun the turn when the sedan approached quickly, though Driver 2 acknowledged they did not see the sedan until impact. A Passenger in the sedan was present and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and neck and stated they felt stiffness after the impact. Driver 1 declined an ambulance at the scene but was advised to seek medical evaluation. Both vehicles sustained front and side damage and were towed from the roadway. No citations were issued at the scene pending further investigation. Witness information was obtained and recorded.
